blocks.header: **C-28** Charlie and Candace drove 8 hours from NC/SC to DC during a hurricane
blocks.label: Charlie and Candace drove 8 hours from NC/SC to DC during a hurricane

lines.v: The host says that when flights were cancelled during a hurricane, she and Charlie Kirk rented a car and drove 8 hours to reach DC by morning, and that she thinks it was in North or South Carolina.
We got to rent a car. We got to drive eight hours. ... And one of the most fun uh road trips I've had in my life.
Cross-reference hurricane event dates in NC/SC to narrow the trip timeframe.

blocks.header: **C-34** YWLS conference reporters pressed Candace during 'him too' controversy
blocks.label: YWLS conference reporters pressed Candace during 'him too' controversy

lines.v: The host says that while the YWLS conference ran at the same time as the 'him too' backlash, reporters who already hated them swooped in asking whether Charlie supported her statements, and that, with her standing behind Charlie and Andrew Kolvet, Charlie held the line.
And then we had at the same time the YWLS conference. So the reporters who already hated us just completely they just swooped in there…
Identify YWLS conference date/location and contemporaneous press coverage of the 'him too' shirt incident.

blocks.header: **C-9** Charlie's 'never say no to Fox News' media rule
blocks.label: Charlie's 'never say no to Fox News' media rule

lines.v: The host says Charlie Kirk's rule was never to say no to Fox News, and that they did as many as four Fox hits a day, up at 4:00 a.m. for 'Fox and Friends First.'
Charlie's rule was never say no to Fox News… four hits a day up at 4:00 a.m. for Fox and Friends First.
Corroborate via TPUSA staff schedules or published Fox booking logs from the cited era.

blocks.label: Charlie was egged by Antifa at a Philadelphia restaurant

We got chased out of a Philadelphia restaurant by Antifa and they threw water and they threw an egg on Charlie.
Identify the restaurant and date via news reports of the incident.

blocks.label: Charlie Approved of George After One Evening

His heart is wonderful. You guys are meant for each other. I see it brilliantly and clearly.
Verify the UK trip date and the text chain contents against any saved screenshots.

blocks.label: Candace joked Erika should marry Charlie for the last name upgrade

lines.v: The host says she joked that Erika Frantzve should marry Charlie Kirk because 'Mrs. Erika Kirk' sounds better than 'Frantzve,' and a shown text exchange between Charlie and Candace says her last name is 'dumb' and 'Marry me. It's a logistics thing.'
Mrs. Erika Kirk sounds so much better than Mrs. Eric. ... "Marry me. It's a logistics thing."
Confirm the text chain timing predates the Kirk/Frantzve marriage announcement.

blocks.header: **C-22** Host Says Kanye's Power Was the TPUSA Tour Hype Song
blocks.label: Host Says Kanye's Power Was the TPUSA Tour Hype Song

lines.v: The host says Kanye West's 'Power' became the de facto theme/hype song for the Turning Point USA tour, played before they went on stage.
Kanye's Power kind of became our theme song for the tour.
Verify through other tour-event footage whether 'Power' was consistently used as hype music.

blocks.header: **C-7** Charlie intended to take over the RNC at age 23
blocks.label: Charlie intended to take over the RNC at age 23

Then I'm going to probably take control of the RNC. I mean, he's 23 years old, right?
No artifact shown backing this anecdote; relies entirely on host recollection.
Cross-reference any other contemporaneous accounts of this stated ambition; flag as self-reported through host.

blocks.label: Don Jr. and Eric Trump gave Charlie Kirk a suit-fitting gift certificate

lines.v: The host recounts that Don Jr., and she thinks Eric Trump, teased Charlie Kirk about his ill-fitting suits and eventually gave him a gift certificate, she believes for his birthday, to a fancy suit place to get fitted.
Don and Eric got him a gift certificate. I think it was for his birthday to a fancy suit place to go get fitted.
Corroborate the gift anecdote with any public statement from Donald Trump Jr. or Eric Trump.

blocks.label: Host Says 150,000 Watched and the Stream Crashed

150,000 of you guys were watching and uh the the system just sort of crashed
Platform viewership or outage records for the broadcast would confirm the figure.

blocks.header: **C-2** Host Says She Did Not Want the Moment of His Death to Be the Last Image of Charlie
blocks.label: Host Says She Did Not Want the Moment of His Death to Be the Last Image of Charlie

lines.v: The host says she held this tribute because she did not want the last thing people had in mind about Charlie Kirk to be the moment he lost his life.
I didn't want the last thing that people had in their minds about Charlie to be the moment he lost his life.
The host's own statement of purpose; compare with the framing of later episodes about the death footage.

blocks.header: **C-3** Host Says She Met Charlie in 2017 When TPUSA Was Very Young
blocks.label: Host Says She Met Charlie in 2017 When TPUSA Was Very Young

lines.v: The host says she met Charlie Kirk in 2017, when Turning Point USA was a very young organization and nobody knew who she or Charlie was.
I met him back in 2017 when Turning Point was this very young organization.
Dated public records of her first appearances with TPUSA in 2017 would corroborate the timeline.

blocks.header: **C-4** Host Says Charlie Hired Her on the Spot at a Florida Conference
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Hired Her on the Spot at a Florida Conference

lines.v: The host says Charlie Kirk hired her on the spot at a conference in Florida.
He hired me on the spot. We were at this conference in Florida.
Identify the Florida conference and the date of her TPUSA hiring from event listings and her early employment records.

blocks.header: **C-5** Host Says Their First Planning Session Was at the Chicago O'Hare Macaroni Grill
blocks.label: Host Says Their First Planning Session Was at the Chicago O'Hare Macaroni Grill

lines.v: The host says their first planning session on their first trip together took place at a Macaroni Grill restaurant in Chicago O'Hare airport, where Charlie drew on a paper menu a map of what Turning Point would become.
He flips over this little paper menu as we're waiting for our flight.
Travel records of that first trip would place both at O'Hare; the menu itself is not shown.

blocks.header: **C-6** Host Says Charlie Wrote That TPUSA Was a 501(c)(3) at the Time
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Wrote That TPUSA Was a 501(c)(3) at the Time

lines.v: The host says that on the menu Charlie wrote that Turning Point's structure was then a 501(c)(3), alongside his aim for it to become the biggest conservative student organization in the world.
not just in the nation, by the way, but in the world. He kind of squabbled and squibbled and wrote that the structure is currently a 501c3.
IRS filings for Turning Point USA would show its tax status and any later restructuring.

blocks.header: **C-8** Host Says Charlie Adored Rush Limbaugh and Wanted a Show Like His
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Adored Rush Limbaugh and Wanted a Show Like His

lines.v: The host says the person Charlie adored most was Rush Limbaugh, that Charlie was raised on Limbaugh's show, and that she thinks his ultimate goal was to have a show like it, which she says happened.
was Rush Limbaugh. He was really raised on Rush Limbaugh,
Charlie's earlier interviews on Limbaugh would corroborate the admiration.

blocks.header: **C-10** Host Says Her Rule Was That the Team Should Not Drink
blocks.label: Host Says Her Rule Was That the Team Should Not Drink

lines.v: The host says her rule was that she and Charlie should not drink, and that they did not drink, because everybody in politics is drinking and she considered it a disadvantage.
My rule was like I was like, we shouldn't drink. Everybody in politics is drinking.
Former TPUSA staff could confirm whether the no-drinking practice applied on the road in 2017 to 2019.

blocks.header: **C-11** Host Says Charlie's Motto Was They Could Always Outwork Their Opponents
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie's Motto Was They Could Always Outwork Their Opponents

lines.v: The host says Charlie's motto, which she says came directly from him, was that they could always outwork their opponents.
Charlie's was we can always outwork our opponents.
Public Charlie Kirk speeches using the phrase would corroborate the attribution.

blocks.header: **C-12** Host Says She Told Charlie Her Goal Was 50,000 Instagram Followers
blocks.label: Host Says She Told Charlie Her Goal Was 50,000 Instagram Followers

lines.v: The host says that going through her text messages the day before she found one in which she told Charlie her goal was 50,000 Instagram followers by the end of the year.
Charlie, my goal is to have 50,000 followers on Instagram. I think we can do it by the end of the year.
The text itself, with its date, would confirm the follower goal and its timing.

blocks.header: **C-13** Host Says Charlie Was Already Running a California Campus Tour When He Hired Her
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Was Already Running a California Campus Tour When He Hired Her

lines.v: The host says that after Charlie hired her he had been working hard on a campus tour throughout California, which he called the big three: UCLA, Stanford and Berkeley.
And after he hired me, he had been working already really hard on doing this campus tour throughout California.
Campus event calendars for UCLA, Stanford and Berkeley would date the tour.

blocks.header: **C-14** Host Says a Bigger Name Messaged That They Would Not Share the Stage With the New Girl
blocks.label: Host Says a Bigger Name Messaged That They Would Not Share the Stage With the New Girl

lines.v: The host says she saw messages light up on Charlie's phone from a better-known headliner, who is not named, saying they did not want to do the event with the new girl Charlie had hired.
"I I don't want to do this event with that new girl you hired." Like,
The headliner is unnamed; the host or the original ticketing for the California event would identify him.

blocks.header: **C-15** Host Says Charlie Chose to Do the Event Without the Headliner Rather Than Drop Her
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Chose to Do the Event Without the Headliner Rather Than Drop Her

lines.v: The host says Charlie decided against the easy choice and said that if the headliner did not want to do the event with Candace, they would not do the event with them and that he and Candace would do it alone.
Candace, then we're not going to do the event." And Candace and I will do it alone.
Event records from the California tour would show who spoke at the event in question.

blocks.header: **C-16** Host Says Dave Rubin Joined That Event
blocks.label: Host Says Dave Rubin Joined That Event

lines.v: The host says she thinks Dave Rubin hopped on for that particular event after Charlie and she went at it alone.
Dave Rubin hopped on and the rest was future.
Event programs or press from the early California tour would show whether Rubin appeared.

blocks.header: **C-17** Host Says She and Charlie Flew Around the World for Two Years on Hundreds of Flights
blocks.label: Host Says She and Charlie Flew Around the World for Two Years on Hundreds of Flights

lines.v: The host says that for two years straight she and Charlie flew around the world together, taking hundreds of flights.
Straight, Charlie and I flew around the world together on very little sleep. We were always exhausted.
Airline itineraries or TPUSA travel expense records for 2017 to 2019 would test the claim.

blocks.header: **C-19** Host Says Charlie Was Frugal and Aware His Salary Came From Donors
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Was Frugal and Aware His Salary Came From Donors

lines.v: The host says Don Jr., and she thinks Eric Trump, told Charlie they knew he was very frugal and aware that his salary came from donors, and that Charlie wanted to be a good steward of the donors' capital.
they're like, you know, Charlie, I know you're very frugal. We know that you're very aware that your salary comes from donors.
Charlie Kirk's reported TPUSA compensation in public filings would test the frugality account.

blocks.header: **C-20** Host Says Charlie Took Up Running 10 Miles a Day After Getting Into Kanye
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Took Up Running 10 Miles a Day After Getting Into Kanye

lines.v: The host says that after she introduced Charlie to Kanye West's music he began running 10 miles a day and texting her about it.
Charlie's really getting into some Kanye West music. He's running 10 miles a day.
Charlie's running habit is attested elsewhere; the host's text messages would place the time.

blocks.header: **C-21** Host Says Charlie Texted That Power Was His New Favorite Song
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Texted That Power Was His New Favorite Song

lines.v: The host says there is a text in which Charlie wrote that Kanye's song was his new favorite song, which she says became the tour's hype song.
He's like, "Yes, it's my new f it's my new favorite song." And he he just loved it.
The text itself would confirm Charlie's wording and date.

blocks.header: **C-23** Host Says Kanye Tweeted That He Loved the Way Candace Owens Thinks
blocks.label: Host Says Kanye Tweeted That He Loved the Way Candace Owens Thinks

lines.v: The host says that a couple of months after they started listening to Kanye's old albums on repeat, Kanye West tweeted "I love the way Candace Owens thinks".
Suddenly, Kanye West tweets, "I love the way Candace Owens thinks." The excitement. Okay,
Kanye West's archived tweets would date the post; the draft's Event Timestamp for the backstage clip says May 2022.

blocks.header: **C-25** Host Says Charlie Repeatedly Texted Her Photos Asking Whether He Looked Cool
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Repeatedly Texted Her Photos Asking Whether He Looked Cool

lines.v: The host says Charlie often texted her a picture asking whether it looked cool, and describes a screen recording of them discussing a pair of sunglasses.
Does this look cool? Does this look cool? Do I look cool?
The screen recording shown would confirm the exchange.

blocks.header: **C-27** Host Says Charlie Drilled Her on Debates by Playing a Protester
blocks.label: Host Says Charlie Drilled Her on Debates by Playing a Protester

lines.v: The host says Charlie hammered her on debate preparation, told her to know opponents' arguments backward and forward, and pretended to be a protester or radical while she memorized statistics.
he was just pretending to be a protester,.
Second-hand accounts from TPUSA staff of their debate preparation sessions would corroborate it.

blocks.header: **C-29** Host Says They Travelled to All 50 States, Canada, the UK and Israel
blocks.label: Host Says They Travelled to All 50 States, Canada, the UK and Israel

lines.v: The host says that she and Charlie went all 50 states, Canada, down to the border, the United Kingdom and Israel.
all 50 states, Canada, down to the border, the United Kingdom, Israel, you name it,
Dated event listings for Charlie Kirk and Candace Owens in the UK and Israel would test the claim.

blocks.header: **C-30** Host Says They Printed a Justice for Brett Kavanaugh T-Shirt
blocks.label: Host Says They Printed a Justice for Brett Kavanaugh T-Shirt

lines.v: The host says they were always printing new T-shirts and names a Justice for Brett Kavanaugh shirt among them.
we were there. And there was always a new t-shirt to print out. Justice for Brett Kavanaugh.
Contemporary TPUSA merchandise listings or photos would confirm the shirt.

blocks.header: **C-31** Host Says She Immediately Called the Me Too Movement Awful
blocks.label: Host Says She Immediately Called the Me Too Movement Awful

lines.v: The host says that when the Me Too hashtag started going viral and people were emotional she immediately said Me Too was awful, terrible for women and for men, and that people attacked her for saying due process was needed.
I won't forget it because that me too hashtag it just started going viral and people were emotional and right away I was like me too is awful.
Her 2017 to 2018 posts and interviews on Me Too would date the first statements.

blocks.header: **C-32** Host Says Young Women at TPUSA Threatened to Quit Over Her Statements
blocks.label: Host Says Young Women at TPUSA Threatened to Quit Over Her Statements

lines.v: The host says young women working at Turning Point were threatening to quit and crying in the office over her Me Too comments.
We're talking about rape. And I remember he had young women at Turning Point who were threatening to quit crying in the office.
TPUSA staff from 2018 could confirm the reaction in the office.

blocks.header: **C-33** Host Says Some of the Young Women Did Quit
blocks.label: Host Says Some of the Young Women Did Quit

lines.v: The host says that some of the young women at Turning Point who objected to her Me Too stance did quit.
How could she not support me too women who young women who did quit?
Departures from TPUSA in 2018 would identify the staff who quit and their stated reasons.

blocks.header: **C-35** Host Says People Demanded Charlie Fire Her and He Refused
blocks.label: Host Says People Demanded Charlie Fire Her and He Refused

lines.v: The host says that people demanded Charlie fire her over her Me Too statements and that he did not, because he agreed with her and held the line.
People, you've got to fire her. How could she say this? And he didn't.
Press coverage of calls for her dismissal in 2018 and any TPUSA statement would test the account.
